recognize_zh: 大腸固有層內密集的淋巴球幾乎全部呈強陽性膜狀 CD8 染色，腺窩上皮為陰性，顯示為單一 CD8+ 細胞毒性 T 細胞族群，是 CD8+ 惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病的特徵。
features: Strong, diffuse membranous CD8 staining in the large majority of lamina propria lymphocytes
Positive cells are small with round nuclei, forming sheets between crypts
Crypt epithelium negative; only rare intraepithelial CD8-positive cells
No clusters of large atypical positive cells
describe_en: CD8 immunohistochemistry on colonic mucosa highlights a dense, sheet-like population of small lymphocytes in the lamina propria with strong membranous staining. Positive cells expand the space between crypts, while the crypt epithelium is negative and intraepithelial lymphocytes are not conspicuously increased. This CD8-predominant population supports a cytotoxic T-cell phenotype and, together with low proliferation and clonal TCR rearrangement, is consistent with CD8-positive indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates retain a mixed CD4/CD8 ratio with prominent plasma cells and B cells, rather than a monotonous CD8-positive sheet.
MEITL is also CD8-positive but shows striking epitheliotropism, CD56 expression and a high Ki-67 index.
The CD4-positive variant shows the opposite pattern, with CD4 highlighting the sheets and CD8 staining only scattered cells.
